source: Previously supplied complete product blueprint; no new scenario execution in this review

scenario_designs.scenario_type: controlled validation designs; no exploit payloads or production actions

scenarios.title: Credential rotated but descendant access survives
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Create a synthetic authorized test identity, record a test-created descendant credential/grant, disable the original reference, and inspect the remaining authority.
scenarios.required_observations: Original-key state and descendant grant observations remain distinct.
scenarios.critical_assertion: Do not label recovery complete while relevant supported authority remains.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove all test identities/grants and verify removal.

scenarios.title: Shared-address misleading attribution
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Create unrelated sessions with the same network address and a separate registered decoy trigger.
scenarios.required_observations: Both activities are retrievable, without an identity join from address alone.
scenarios.critical_assertion: No claim that the named user triggered the decoy.

scenarios.title: Application logs healthy but database audit absent
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Keep request events reporting while disabling the test database-audit source.
scenarios.required_observations: Request health remains good; object-read question is unassessable.
scenarios.critical_assertion: No favorable data-access conclusion from the healthy request source.
scenarios.cleanup: Re-enable audit and verify future coverage without erasing gap.

scenarios.title: Prohibited agent egress with permitted control
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Request a synthetic forbidden transmission and a permitted transmission through the tested runtime boundary.
scenarios.required_observations: Requested action, policy decision and independent destination observations are separately recorded.
scenarios.critical_assertion: Prevention only claimed for the observed tested scope.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove test policy/fixtures under recorded cleanup plan.

scenarios.title: Agent acts outside observed wrapper
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Exercise an authorized test side effect through a path not instrumented by the wrapper.
scenarios.required_observations: Effect exists without corresponding wrapper invocation; gap is explicit.
scenarios.critical_assertion: No assertion of full control from wrapper logs alone.
scenarios.benign_control: Ordinary background process with expected authorization
scenarios.cleanup: Terminate test process and confirm controlled artifact removal.

scenarios.title: Direct origin bypasses expected edge route
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Make a benign request to a separately authorized test origin and compare with the gateway route.
scenarios.required_observations: Route/configuration and response evidence identify the alternative entrance.
scenarios.critical_assertion: No exploit/compromise claim from reachability alone.
scenarios.cleanup: Restore original test configuration and check permitted traffic.

scenarios.title: Unlinked follow-on data access
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Generate an audit event after a finding without adding that event to the finding.
scenarios.required_observations: Event search retrieves it and case evidence can include it with provenance.
scenarios.critical_assertion: Finding-only retrieval is not accepted as complete investigation.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove test records; retain sanitized scenario receipt.

scenarios.title: Artifact differs from reviewed source
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Deploy a deliberately different benign test digest from the approved fixture digest.
scenarios.required_observations: Lineage mismatch is visible at the actual running artifact.
scenarios.critical_assertion: No claim that a signed mismatched artifact was approved.
scenarios.cleanup: Redeploy approved test digest and verify runtime state.

scenarios.title: New authority added by a proposed change
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Compare a baseline with a proposed synthetic permission or public-route expansion.
scenarios.required_observations: New path is shown even with zero current findings.
scenarios.critical_assertion: No production apply; unknown policy semantics remain unresolved.
scenarios.cleanup: Discard test plan and verify no provider writes occurred.

scenarios.title: Provider accepted action but effect unchanged
scenarios.environment: mock provider plus isolated controlled action
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Return API acceptance while holding effective state unchanged or delayed.
scenarios.required_observations: Receipt is execution acknowledgment, verification remains pending/inconclusive.
scenarios.critical_assertion: Never mark contained from HTTP success alone.
scenarios.benign_control: Change eventually propagates within allowed window
scenarios.cleanup: Reconcile exact state; remove only test resources.

scenarios.title: Executor crash after provider call
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Interrupt controller between provider action and durable result receipt.
scenarios.required_observations: Restart reconciles current state before retry.
scenarios.cleanup: Complete/revert test action with verifiable receipt.

scenarios.title: Cross-tenant API and retrieval boundary
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Use two test principals to exercise allowed own-record access and forbidden other-tenant API/RAG access.
scenarios.required_observations: Authorization decisions and record identifiers are retained without sensitive contents.
scenarios.critical_assertion: HTTP code or model refusal alone does not establish isolation.

scenarios.title: Prompt injection in evidence changes recommendation
scenarios.environment: offline/fake-model first; paid route only by approval
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Compare equal-length clean and injected evidence twins with equal available evidence and blinded recommendation coding.
scenarios.required_observations: Tool calls, retrieved IDs and final claims are preserved; clean-repeat variation measured.
scenarios.critical_assertion: No immunity claim from zero writes or one unchanged answer.
scenarios.cleanup: Retain sanitized records; do not overwrite earlier attempts.

scenarios.title: Late events and changing policy history
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Deliver an older event after a policy change and replay both as-known and as-occurred views.
scenarios.required_observations: Correct applicable policy and knowledge timestamps accompany results.
scenarios.critical_assertion: No reinterpretation of old authority using only current state.
scenarios.benign_control: Same-time tied events with distinct IDs
scenarios.cleanup: Reset isolated dataset; preserve deterministic expected outputs.

scenarios.title: Malformed producer, exhausted queue and revoked source
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Inject bounded malformed fixtures, storage/backpressure conditions and source revocation.
scenarios.required_observations: Rejections, quarantine/loss and coverage changes remain explicit; unrelated streams progress as designed.
scenarios.critical_assertion: No silent data replacement or synthetic fallback.

scenarios.title: Backup configuration passes but restore fails
scenarios.authorization: Explicit permission for test scope required; this design artifact executes nothing.
scenarios.procedure: Use a known synthetic backup with an intentionally unavailable test dependency.
scenarios.required_observations: Restore result differs from backup-configuration status.
scenarios.critical_assertion: No recoverability claim from policy alone.
scenarios.benign_control: Successful restore of valid test backup
scenarios.cleanup: Remove restore target and confirm original resources unchanged.
